<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 134.10955 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of approximately 133.102 Da. The molecular formula that best matches this exact mass within typical MS accuracy is C₆H₁₃O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H13O3</final_answer>
